scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: npm install --no-save concurrently && concurrently --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "cd backend && poetry run uvicorn discovita.app:app --reload --port 8000" "cd frontend/apps/identity-generator && PORT=3000 npm start"
scripts.build: cd frontend/apps/identity-generator && npm run build && cd ../../.. && rm -rf backend/public/* && cp -r frontend/apps/identity-generator/build/* backend/public/
scripts.start: cd backend && poetry run uvicorn discovita.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8000}
